scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 02 better preserves source-relative nuclear scale, count and nearest-neighbor spacing with the same approved tissue geometry.

All three candidates pass the frozen hard gates. Candidate 02 provides the most balanced source-relative cell scale, count and nearest-neighbor distribution while retaining a coherent moderate tumor-boundary expansion.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 50,791-pixel joint change follows the authorized tumor-stroma interface as a continuous boundary expansion; its 41,922-pixel tissue component preserves the surrounding non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Sixteen placed nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.993, 0.855, 1.027 and 1.180, giving the most source-like overall balance among the three candidates.
decisions.coupling: Nuclei are coupled to the authorized transition without crossing protected structures; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass, with sampling score 0.886.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, support-exterior instances and prohibited tissue remain unchanged, with no partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violation.
decisions.limitations: Ripley clustering is mildly elevated and the edited mask alone cannot establish generated-H&E quality, clinical plausibility or outcome validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
